title: Canonical Economic Event Contract
branch_scope: phase-5/prep — additive only; no activation; no merge to main until Phases 0–4 fossils exist
purpose: One shared event model for payment intent, settlement, order attribution, fulfilment, delivery, and independent verification across all silos and platform offers. A successful checkout or Stripe redirect is never verified revenue.
reconciles_with: existing economic-event schema on main (extend and enforce; do not fork a competing system)
non_goals: Does not allow dual settlement owners

verified_revenue_requires: settlement event with independent payment evidence
fulfilment event linked to that order
delivery evidence where the product type requires it
no double-count of the same payment identity

payment_intent.description: Buyer started checkout or intent was created. Not revenue.

settlement.description: Payment captured/settled by the processor. Required before verified revenue.
settlement.note: Settlement alone is not fulfilment or delivery.

order_attributed.description: CSO created exactly one order for a settled payment with canonical SKU and silo attribution.

fulfilment.description: Fulfilment job admitted and/or completed for the order.

delivery.description: Buyer-controlled delivery evidence (artifact, receipt, shipment, access grant).

verification.description: Independent check that the chain is complete and consistent. Only then may totals include this payment.
verification.only_when: status == VERIFIED and no compensating reversal

reversal.description: Refund, chargeback, or void. Must compensate attributed totals.
reversal.effect: net out prior verification for the same payment identity

envelope.description: Minimum fields on every economic event. Event-type-specific fields are additive.

event_id.description: Stable unique id for this event record (not necessarily Stripe event.id).

payment_identity.description: Durable key for the payment (e.g. Stripe pi_/cs_/charge id or equivalent). Used for idempotency and anti double-count.

processor_event_id.description: Stripe event.id or equivalent when applicable; primary dedup key at CSO ingress.

order_id.description: Required once order_attributed exists; shared across linked events for the same order.

amount.description: Minor units (e.g. cents). Required on settlement, order_attributed, verification, reversal.

currency.description: ISO currency, lowercase or uppercase consistently (prefer nzd).

source_refs.description: Processor ids, fossil paths, artifact hashes, delivery refs.

idempotency.processor_event_id: At CSO ingress, event.id must be deduplicated. Second delivery = DUPLICATE, no second order.
idempotency.payment_identity: At most one open order and one admitted fulfilment job per settled payment_identity unless an explicit multi-job contract says otherwise.
idempotency.verification: The same payment_identity may contribute to verified revenue totals only once; reversals net out.
idempotency.job_ledger: Admit job only if not already admitted for that payment_identity / job key.

linkage_rules: order_attributed.order_id is the sole order id for downstream fulfilment and delivery events
fulfilment.order_id and delivery.order_id must match order_attributed.order_id
verification must reference the same payment_identity and order_id
No event may change silo_id or sku_id after order_attributed without a compensating correction fossil
cso_ingress_sequence: Verify Stripe signature on raw body
Attribute silo via SKU → silo registry
Admit at most one fulfilment job
Emit fossils for each step outcome

fail_closed_rules.condition: Event processed by non-owner endpoint attempting order creation
No allowed SKU key or unknown SKU
Fulfilment or delivery without prior settlement + order_attributed
Public or Discord total includes amount without verification event
payment_intent or redirect treated as verified revenue

may_report: counts and sums derived only from verification events with status VERIFIED, net of reversals
per-silo breakdowns from the same events
explicit zeros when no verification events exist
must_not_report: checkout starts or abandoned sessions as revenue

required_tests.expect: verified total decreases by reversed amount
single silo attribution only; no double-count

next_commits: executable adversarial tests wiring both contracts into gates
adoption.production: Not binding on main until reconciled with live CSO path, tested, and Phases 0–4 fossils exist.
